# Future Goals

```{=html}
<p class="fg-intro">I'm graduating in April 2026 with a clear sense of where I want to go, not just professionally, but personally. Here's what I'm working towards.</p>
```

## Career

```{=html}
<div class="goal-cards">
<div class="goal-card">
<span class="goal-label">Short term</span>
<div class="goal-title">Business analyst in the gaming industry</div>
<p class="goal-body">My goal after graduating is to work as a business analyst, ideally within the gaming industry. It's a sector I find genuinely exciting: fast-moving, data-driven, and creatively ambitious. I want to be part of a team where analytical thinking shapes real product decisions.</p>
</div>
<div class="goal-card">
<span class="goal-label">Location</span>
<div class="goal-title">Working abroad in London</div>
<p class="goal-body">London is one of Europe's biggest hubs for tech and gaming companies. Moving there after graduation is a goal I'm actively working towards. The exposure, the network, and the pace of the industry there is exactly the environment I want to grow in early in my career.</p>
</div>
</div>
```

## Travel

```{=html}
<div class="goal-cards">
<div class="goal-card">
<span class="goal-label">Summer 2026</span>
<div class="goal-title">Explore beyond Europe</div>
<p class="goal-body">Before stepping into the workforce full-time, I want to take the summer after graduation to travel, not just within Europe, but across different continents. Experiencing new cultures, places, and perspectives is something I believe makes you a better thinker and a better professional.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="milestone-grid">

</div>

</div>
```
